text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...!
A fire in such a narrow alley...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smoke was pouring out of a fourth-floor unit in an old commercial building down the alley.
A few people, likely residents, were gazing up anxiously.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Um, did you all evacuate? Please try to stay calm.
Also... has everyone inside managed to get out safely?

text_block_list.name: Frantic Woman
text_block_list.text:
Well, the lady on the second floor is still inside...!
We banged on her door and shouted, but she won't listen to a word...!

text_block_list.name: Helpless Man
text_block_list.text:
That old lady doesn't trust anyone anymore.
Ever since she got scammed, she completely shut herself off from the world...

text_block_list.name: Helpless Man
text_block_list.text:
When I was a kid, she was always so kind and played with us...
Damn it... What are we supposed to do?!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...It's an old building. There's no telling how fast the flames might spread.
We have to get her out before the danger reaches her.
choice_data_list: Don't tell me... you're going to persuade her yourself?!
Don't tell me... you're going to persuade her yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No matter who she is—
no one deserves to be left in harm's way!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(The hallway is so dark... It must be because the fire started in the old electrical wiring...
I have to hurry so we can get her out safely without causing a panic.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If the flames spread, it won't be safe here either.
...Please, come with me and evacuate!

text_block_list.name: Despairing Woman
text_block_list.text:
Leave me alone! Everyone treats me like a nuisance anyway!
No matter what happens to me, you'd all just be glad to be rid of me!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...No one out there thinks that way.
Everyone is genuinely worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Despairing Woman
text_block_list.text:
Why should I believe you?! When I was in trouble, nobody lifted a finger to help!
I'm completely alone in this world!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Downstairs, I just met someone
who remembered playing with you when they were a child.

text_block_list.name: Despairing Woman
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If they resented you, why would they be so worried?
If they didn't care, why would they fondly recall those memories?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—There are people who would mourn you.
Even if you feel completely alone, the bonds you made are still alive.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Misunderstandings and drift can happen, but facing each other can reconnect those ties.
So... please. Come with me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a brief exchange, she managed to persuade the resident and guide her outside.
The firefighters arrived shortly after and fortunately extinguished the fire before it could spread.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for worrying you.
But... I'm just so glad everyone made it out safe.

text_block_list.name: Helpless Man
text_block_list.text:
Grandma! ...I'm so sorry. When you were going through a rough patch,
if only I'd listened to you more, you wouldn't have felt so isolated.

text_block_list.name: Helpless Man
text_block_list.text:
From now on... let's talk more, just like we used to.
I'm not the only one who remembers how much you looked out for us back then.

text_block_list.name: Rescued Woman
text_block_list.text:
...Oh... I'm so sorry for causing such a fuss.
To you... and to you, young lady.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I'm so glad...
That you chose to believe in the bond that remained.

text_block_list.name: Rescued Woman
text_block_list.text: ...Are you crying...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Because I know that you're going to be okay now.

text_block_list.name: Rescued Woman
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. What a strange girl you are.
Still... thank you. You're very kind, dear.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: You want to know my reasons...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, no one was hurt. Even so, running into a burning building
to rescue a complete stranger isn't something just anyone can do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let alone a student who bore no official duty or responsibility.
And yet, she hadn't hesitated for a single moment.
choice_data_list: What made you go that far?
What made you go that far?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Well, let's see.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Because I want to connect people... I suppose?

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Pisa-chan, run with me next!

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Okay!
Let's all do our best and go to Tracen Academy together!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My parents, the cheering adults, the friends who ran alongside me.
Racing gave my younger self so many precious connections.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—And yet, life's cruel misfortunes...
can sever those bonds in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Young Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Pisa-chan...! I'm scared, I'm so scared...!

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The building is...! 
Where is everyone...?!

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Father
text_block_list.text:
It's dangerous here, get back!
Come on! Hurry!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A fire broke out at our local junior training facility.
Thankfully, there were no casualties, but—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—many of the girls became terrified of running
and drifted away from racing entirely.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —Even so.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I am standing right here.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since that fire, this place has gotten so quiet.
Things might never go back to the way they were...

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Dad? If I keep running and never give up...
do you think everyone will come back...?

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to see everyone again.
I want us to smile and run together. So... I'll keep running."

text_block_list.name: Young Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Even when we're sad, or lonely...
If we all hold hands, I know we can make each other happy!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —...I want to weave hope.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
To stand beside others. To connect our hearts. To banish loneliness from this world.
I believe that if we do, we can one day create a circle of hope that connects the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
These hands are meant to reach out to those who are alone.
These legs are meant to show them hope by running endlessly forward.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how much I can achieve on my own.
Even so... what I couldn't do back then, I hope to do someday.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was pure, unconditional selflessness. Her wish to "connect hearts with others and weave hope"
was the very guiding principle of her life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It wasn't just how she lived her daily life—it was tied directly to what she wanted to achieve through racing as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It made sense why I couldn't spot an obvious goal before.
It was so grand that it simply couldn't be seen through a narrow lens.
choice_data_list: You really are... like an angel, aren't you?
You truly are... like an angel, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Touching upon her endlessly pure and precious convictions,
I felt a warm glow kindle deep within my chest.
